guidance.claim: Will eliminate smart meter receivables before the year ends.
guidance.quote: So going forward, we will make sure that before this year is over, we get rid of these receivables with appropriate financing so that it's not in our books
guidance.speaker: Management

guidance.claim: Approximately INR240 crores of receivables will be discounted.
guidance.quote: So, we are quite confident that INR240 crores, approximately INR240 crores of such receivables will anyway get discounted and it'll reduce the amount.
guidance.speaker: Management

guidance.claim: Working capital normalization measures are underway and expected to show visible improvement.
guidance.quote: Working capital normalization measures are already underway and expected to show visible improvement going forward.
guidance.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

guidance.claim: Expects about INR300-odd crores in second half execution.
guidance.quote: And then, of course, in the second half, we also plan some execution, which will be of the nature of about INR300-odd crores.
guidance.speaker: Jairam Sampath

guidance.claim: Near-term free cash flow unlikely as capital must be reinvested for growth.
guidance.quote: FCF, I'm not sure in the near-term that will happen because we'll have to reinvest for growth.
guidance.speaker: Jairam Sampath

reported.claim: Reported FY25 revenues of 27.2 billion, a 51% year-on-year increase.
reported.quote: So Kaynes reported FY25 revenues of 27.2 billion, 51% year-on-year increase.
reported.speaker: Jairam Sampath

reported.claim: H2 FY25 net margin is 9% with INR5,327 million revenue.
reported.quote: Now the H2 FY '25 net margin is only 9% actually, the revenues of INR5,327 million and PAT of INR489 million.
reported.speaker: Jairam Sampath

reported.claim: Smart meter business receivables total about INR687 crores as of September.
reported.quote: Now, as of September, I think the total receivables is about – yes, of the total receivables, about INR687 crores pertains to business of smart meters, which includes also the other non -current assets portion.
reported.speaker: Management
